outcome: Accuracy of ultrasound measurement of LUS
cohort: 311 pregnant women with one previous cesarean delivery
finding: Transvaginal ultrasound measurement of the lower uterine segment is accurate and can be used to guide decisions regarding mode of birth in resource-limited settings.
mod_finding: Successful vaginal birth rate correlated with increasing mLUS values, suggesting that ultrasound measurement of LUS can help predict successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery.
